recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: The 569i top-k conversion PASS is env-conditional (reef-bipartite structural candidate-divergence guarantee). On the axis-b saturated-threat env it does NOT propagate: z_harm_a saturates ~6 (trained harm pathway over-drives the 625b-era hazard_harm=0.2/proximity_harm_scale=0.2 overlay ~14x) and the candidate pool collapses (cand_world_pairwise_dist < 0.03 on 2/3). The 625e successor must (a) recalibrate the axis-b overlay ~10x DOWN into a sub-saturating band AND pulse/time-vary the threat so z_harm_a can relieve and cross 0.4 downward; (b) adopt the 603q-stabilized harm-pathway config (decoupled encoder LR + warmup) so the harm landscape forms on >=2/3 seeds; (c) keep the GAP-A conversion-propagation (R3/R4) as a hard upstream gate -- a recalibrated threat alone will not clear the candidate-pool collapse. The conversion-propagation half is a POINTER to the shared behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-A / modulatory-bias-selection-authority ceiling, not a new build.

learning_extracted: 569i's conversion PASS is env-conditional: it rests on the reef-bipartite env's structural guarantee of categorically-opposite first-action argmaxes; it does not propagate to a saturated-threat regime that removes that guarantee.

The trained harm pathway changes z_harm_a magnitude ~14x vs the untrained base the axis-b overlay was calibrated against (625b p70~0.43 -> 625d mean~6); the overlay and the plan's target ranges need re-derivation, and the threat must be time-varying/pulsed so z_harm_a can cross downward (C3a fix), not just magnitude-tuned.
603p harm-pathway seed-fragility is implicated (flat harm_eval on 2/3 seeds); a 625d successor should adopt the 603q-stabilized harm config.
Nth autopsy circling the committed-action-diversity / F-dominance locus (569g/569h/614e + the GAP-A amend chain) -- granularity-debt signal; 625d adds the env-conditional-conversion edge.

claim_synthesis_recommendation.rationale: This is the Nth /failure-autopsy circling the committed-action-diversity / F-dominance / committed-argmax-collapse locus, each with a distinct failure signature (569g entropy-only artefact; 569h conversion-ceiling-persists; 614e z_world candidate-pool collapse; 460e beta-engagement; plus the long modulatory-bias-selection-authority amend chain gap-relative->float32->route-range->gain/contrast->top-k). The recurrence across separate autopsy sessions is the granularity-debt signal: the broad GAP-A claim is probably several finer testable claims (candidate-pool-divergence vs route-range-reach vs F-dominance-budget vs env-structural-precondition), not one. 625d adds the env-conditional-conversion edge (conversion success contingent on an upstream env-structural candidate-divergence guarantee). Proposal-first, lit-grounded decomposition -- NOT demotion (the claim is coarse, not wrong).
